resources.string:
Left mode
• Tap: left click.
• Swipe with one finger while zoomed in: pan the view without clicking the remote desktop.
• Tap twice quickly: double click.
• Tap, then touch again nearby and keep the second touch down while dragging: move a window or select text. Lift your finger to release.

Two fingers
• Pinch to zoom; move both fingers to pan.

Other controls
• Right mode: tap for a right click.
• Scroll mode: swipe vertically to scroll the remote desktop.
• Floating right-click button: arm it, then tap the desktop once for a right click.
• A long press alone does not produce a right click.

Physical mouse
• Hold the left button and move to drag; release it to finish. Right click and the wheel retain their usual behavior.
